# The thing the reader makes

This tutorial is for a reader who is new to logex. Say in 1 sentence what the reader
makes. Say in 1 sentence what the reader learns.

Copy this file to `guides/tutorials/`, give it a name and add its line to
`docs/pages.exs`. Then replace each paragraph with the text of the lesson.

## What you make

Show the result first: the drawing of the program, or the output of the last step. Tell
the reader what to see in the picture.

## Before you start

- Say what the reader must have: the toolchain, a directory, the files of a different
  page.
- Link to the page that gives each of them.

## Step 1: Give the step a command as its title

1. Give 1 action in each numbered step. Use a command: "Make a file with the name
   `motor.ld`."
2. Show the file or the script in a code block with its mark.
3. Show the result of the step: the output that the reader sees.

Explain only what the step needs. Link to an explanation page for the reasons.

## Step 2: Give the next step a command as its title

1. Keep 1 safe path. Give no choices.
2. Tell the reader about a surprise before the step, in a callout.

## What you learned

- List each new word and each new skill, with a link to the glossary or the reference.

## See also

- Link to the next tutorial.
- Link to the how-to guides and the reference pages for this subject.
